ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 no-show cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher (NS-7); send the driver's account for review of abuse of the "I'm Here" button (350 m from pickup, driver_arrived_at null) + flag_account

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's post-trip statement that he pressed 'I'm Here' and waited over 3 minutes at the pickup is contradicted by GPS/timeline records: nearest approach 288 m, tap at 350 m, 0 s within 200 m, driver_arrived_at null (F1, F2, F4, F5). System records override statements.
Driver's chat claim 'Waited more than 3 min, cancelling' describes waiting 350 m from the pickup point (F2), which does not satisfy the at-pickup requirement of NS-1 (ii) or (iii).
